title: Overdrive power skills
description: The service's answer to GET /v1/power-skills?from&to (spec §6.3, §8.3, ADR 0042): the best average power the rider has held at twelve durations (15 s, 30 s, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45 and 60 minutes) over a window of local days and over all time, and a level for each of five groups of durations (skills). Only the rides recorded on the tablet count: outdoor rides and the watch's workouts never feed it (spec §11.8). window is the range asked for, the local days from `from` to `to` (both included; by default the last 56 days up to today in the rider's time zone; at most 1096 days, which is three years) and rideCount, the number of rides in it that have a power curve. durations has exactly the twelve durations in the order above; for each, `window` is the best mean-maximal power among the rides of the window with the watts, the ride and the local day it came from (the later ride when two tie), and `allTime` the best among all rides up to the end of the window; either is null when no ride is long enough for that duration. wattsPerKg is the watts divided by riderWeight.kg, to two decimals, and is present exactly when riderWeight is. riderWeight is the rider's 7-day average weight from the watch (kg to one decimal, asOf the local day of the newest weighing in the average) and is absent when the service does not know it; the same weight is used for every figure, today's, not the weight of the day of the ride. skills has the five groups in a fixed order: Sprint (15 to 30 s), Attack (1 to 3 min), Climb (5 to 10 min), Time trial (15 to 30 min) and Endurance (45 to 60 min). A skill's level is the best level the window's efforts reach at any of its durations, each judged against that duration's own thresholds in watts per kilogram (nine levels, our own scale: ADR 0042 gives the table and says that it is approximate and not tied to sex or age): index 1 to 9 and its name, bestWattsPerKg and atSeconds (the watts per kilogram at the duration that gave the level, and that duration), and nextLevelWattsPerKg (what that same duration needs for the next level; absent at level 9). level is null when the weight is not known or the window has no effort at any of the skill's durations. levelsNote and outdoorNote are plain sentences the app shows as they are. generatedAt is when the service computed the answer (UTC). Rules a schema cannot state, checked by every implementation: dates and instants are real; from is not after to and the window is at most 1096 days; the durations are the twelve in order; an effort's day is inside the window (window) or not after its end (allTime) and a window effort has an allTime effort at least as high; with rideCount 0 no window effort exists; wattsPerKg is watts over riderWeight.kg to two decimals; the skills are the five in order with their names and ranges; a level's name is the one of its index, atSeconds is one of the skill's durations that has a window effort whose wattsPerKg is bestWattsPerKg, nextLevelWattsPerKg is above bestWattsPerKg and present exactly below level 9; level is null exactly when there is no weight or no window effort among the skill's durations.
